costDetail: Maximize assigned orders, then minimize the sum of assignment costs in cents.
delayDetail: Maximize assigned orders, then minimize the sum of assignment delay estimates in minutes. This is not elapsed shift time.
constraints: Only listed eligibility edges are allowed. Availability and capacity are required. The package caps each technician at three orders. Up to 32 orders, 32 technicians and 128 total records.
recordsDetail: Open a local export containing work_orders, technicians and eligibility, directly or in a tables → records envelope. This does not connect to or refresh an external service. Maximum 512 KB.
sheetDetail: Use one sheet or CSV per named table. Keep stable source identifiers. Review the columns and values; identifiers are never generated from row positions. Values only, up to 2 MB per file.
fileError: Could not open this source. Check its format, named tables and size. Any previous review remains available.
mapping: Select a sheet and a distinct column for every field.
duplicate: Use distinct source sheets, columns and record identifiers; eligibility pairs must be unique.
type: Use a nonempty identifier, true/false availability, or a whole number from 0 to 1000000 as required by this field. Identifiers: 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
reference: This identifier must match a record in the referenced table.
limit: Use at most 32 orders, 32 technicians and 128 total records.
extra: Remove fields outside this table’s contract from the source export and reopen it.
confirm: I confirm these identifiers, columns and values
unavailable: Input preparation only. Package execution is not connected to an authenticated service in this application. No plan has been run.
localDetail: Runs the bundled free maintenance package on this device. Files are not sent to a server. Maximum run time: 10 seconds.
localTimeout: The local run exceeded 10 seconds. Reduce the input and retry.
localFailed: The local run failed. Check the input and retry.
